glosses: it won't do to …; you mustn't …
patterns.usage_note: Spoken contraction of では/ては attaching to a verb in te-form: doing the action, once or repeatedly, is presented as leading to a bad outcome, so it very often lands as a warning to the listener and is frequently closed with だめだ or いけない. じゃ appears wherever the te-form is voiced (む/ぶ/ぬ and ぐ godan verbs: 飲[の]んじゃ, 泳[およ]いじゃ) and ちゃ elsewhere. Unlike 0622, this sense builds on an action someone performs rather than on a state of affairs, and it does not take a bare noun.

examples.ruby: そんなに飲[の]んじゃ明日[あした]の朝[あさ]が辛[つら]いよ。
examples.english: Drink that much and you'll pay for it in the morning.

examples.ruby: 途中[とちゅう]でやめちゃ今[いま]までの努力[どりょく]が無駄[むだ]だよ。
examples.english: Quit halfway and everything you've put in so far goes to waste.

examples.ruby: 毎日[まいにち]夜更[よふ]かしをしちゃ授業[じゅぎょう]に集中[しゅうちゅう]できない。
examples.english: Stay up late every night and you'll never be able to focus in class.
